Name: Grandpa's Trust
Author: SourceNineLabs
Description:
[size=5]Grandpa's Trust[/size]

An immersive, configurable inheritance-benefit system for Stardew Valley. After taking over Grandpa's farm, the farm owner receives a formal approval letter, chooses a weekly, biweekly, or seasonal payment schedule, and manages the claim through annual correspondence and a detailed Benefits Ledger.

[size=4]Version 0.8.0 beta[/size]

Version 0.8.0 is the recommended first public beta after shared-wallet and separate-wallet co-op testing was completed.

[size=4]Features[/size]

[list]
[*]An in-world approval letter from the Ferngill Agricultural Benefits Office.[/*]
[*]A native Stardew response form for choosing weekly, biweekly, or seasonal payments.[/*]
[*]Equal value over time: less-frequent schedules combine the weekly value into larger deposits.[/*]
[*]No payments before enrollment.[/*]
[*]A one-time enrollment confirmation with the selected amount and first deposit date.[/*]
[*]Annual benefit reviews beginning in year 2, including an optional schedule-change form.[/*]
[*]A permanent claim number and Claim File for each farm.[/*]
[*]A Benefits Ledger with recent deposits, transaction references, yearly totals, lifetime totals, schedule history, and correspondence status.[/*]
[*]Configurable payment amounts and notification options through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Console fallbacks when Generic Mod Config Menu is not installed.[/*]
[*]Host-authoritative multiplayer behavior which prevents duplicate co-op payments.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Default payments[/size]

[list]
[*]Year 1: 500g weekly, 1,000g biweekly, or 2,000g seasonally.[/*]
[*]Year 2: 750g weekly, 1,500g biweekly, or 3,000g seasonally.[/*]
[*]Year 3 onward: 1,000g weekly, 2,000g biweekly, or 4,000g seasonally.[/*]
[/list]All schedules are anchored to Spring 8 of year 1 and have the same value over time.

[size=4]Multiplayer[/size]

The trust is a single farm-owned claim managed by the host.

[list]
[*]With shared money, one complete payment is deposited once into the shared farm wallet.[/*]
[*]With separate money, the payment goes to the farm owner's wallet.[/*]
[*]Farmhands never create duplicate claims or payments by joining, reconnecting, or using split-screen.[/*]
[*]Only the host needs the mod installed for payments to function.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Requirements[/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional and only required for in-game settings and the graphical Benefits Ledger page.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Installation[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the compiled [i][b]GrandpasTrust [/b][/i]folder into [i][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/i].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Do not place the ZIP in the Mods folder.

[size=4]Updating from an earlier private version[/size]

Remove any earlier private test build before installing version 0.8.0. This version finalizes the public and internal identity, so saves used with a private pre-release build will enroll fresh under Grandpa's Trust.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]

Grandpa's Trust uses SMAPI events and additive edits to uniquely named mail entries. It does not use Harmony patches, replace the mail asset, edit maps, add NPCs or items, alter shops, add hotkeys, intercept controls, or change Stardew's time and calendar behavior.

[size=4]Console commands[/size]

[list]
[*][b]grandpastrust_status [/b]— show enrollment, active schedule, next deposit, and totals.[/*]
[*][b]grandpastrust_ledger [/b]— show the complete Claim File and Benefits Ledger.[/*]
[*][b]grandpastrust_enroll [/b]— reopen the schedule-selection form.[/*]
[*][b]grandpastrust_pay [/b]— issue one manual test payment after enrollment.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Uninstalling[/size]

Remove the compiled [b][i]GrandpasTrust [/i][/b]folder from [b][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/b]. The mod does not add custom items, NPCs, maps, or locations, so removing it does not leave missing game assets. Its historical save-data entry remains inert unless the mod is installed again.

[size=4]Feedback for the beta[/size]

When reporting an issue, include:

[list]
[*]The SMAPI log link.[/*]
[*]Whether the farm is single-player, shared-wallet co-op, or separate-wallet co-op.[/*]
[*]Whether the issue occurred for the host or a farmhand.[/*]
[*]The active payment schedule and in-game date.[/*]
[*]The exact steps which produced the issue.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Grandpa’s Trust 0.9.0 adds optional integration with Pelican Valley Bank.

Trust distributions can now be sent to your Pocket, PVB Checking account, or PVB Savings account. Deposits sent to Savings can earn Pelican Valley Bank’s normal seasonal interest.
